page.overview:
Who is Cera?

Cera was one of three female Triceratops that could be encountered at the Triceratops Encounter attraction at Universal's Islands of Adventure in Orlando, Florida alongside her sisters Topper and Chris.

Guests could meet Cera at the Triceratops Encounter where they could take photos of the dinosaur and interact with it. Sometimes baby Triceratops twins Sierra and Sahara would also be featured in the attraction.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w_Lhagjc_wc

Due to the Triceratops Encounter's closure in 2010, neither Cera nor her sisters can be seen by the public anymore.
